svg.title: A little donkey eating ZiDiYao’s contribution carrots
svg.desc: A looping animation based on the real public GitHub contribution calendar. Each carrot is an active day. The donkey visits every day and eats the carrots. Brighter carrots mean more contributions.
svg.text: A little donkey. A year of carrots.
79 active days to munch through · grown from my real contributions
Brighter carrots = more contributions · the harvest starts again every loop
